Researchers create the first multi-omic atlas of the developing thalamus, revealing how its neuronal nuclei form

The study reconstructs the developmental trajectories of neurons in the embryonic thalamus.

Peer-Reviewed Publication

Universidad Miguel Hernandez de Elche

Led by Spanish researchers at the Institute for Neurosciences, the study reconstructs the developmental trajectories of neurons in the embryonic thalamus.

The findings identify the transcription factor SP9 as a key regulator of visual neuron development.

Journal
Nature Neuroscience
Funder
Agencia Estatal de Investigación, European Research Council
